title: RiskAssessmentOutput
description: Advisory output of the LLM risk assessor (D8-7, ADR-0016). The LLM may veto and name a regime bucket, but never produces a volume — final_volume is always computed deterministically.

veto.description: Hard veto. true rejects the proposal outright; conservative by design.

regime_bucket.description: Regime classification used to look up the deterministic risk-adjustment multiplier.

risk_notes.description: Free-form risk observations; advisory only, never a sizing input.
